title: Actor
description: Canonical actor representation for attribution, audit, and causation. Owner: platform/contracts.

actor_id.description: Stable identifier of the actor (user, service account, or system).

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope of the actor. Required for multi-tenant isolation.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for audit logs and UI rendering.

roles.description: Roles held by the actor within the tenant at the time of action.
